# Filter the dataframe to find the row with Title "Robin Hood Play"
robin_hood_row = df[df['Title'] == 'Robin Hood Play']

# Get the Series # of that episode
robin_hood_series_num = robin_hood_row['Series #'].iloc[0]

# Find the episode with Series # one less than that
previous_episode_row = df[df['Series #'] == robin_hood_series_num - 1]

# Extract the Title of the previous episode
previous_episode_title = previous_episode_row['Title'].iloc[0]

# Assign the answer
answer = previous_episode_title
